0022600093.text: The Clippers open their 2026-27 season at home against the Sacramento Kings, who have also not played a game yet this season. Los Angeles will be without Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), while Sacramento is missing Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 win over Sacramento on April 5, 2026, in Sacramento, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Clippers a 65% chance to win.
